page.layout: One page of text, single column. Running head at top centre. Headings and verses in full width. No marginal notes outside the text block.

l.i: Altera Deucalion picta tabella tua est.
Et pretio rogitas quónam sit dignus uterque?
Ille quidem flammis, hic bene dignus aquis.
Ecce tibi quale argentum Burgundia gignit,
Quaque etiam salsa munera fundit aqua:
Dulcis opum gustus, sale nil contra acrius uno:
Integra sic hominum symbola fortis habes.
Faxit at ille tua Dominus qui pocula vita
Temperat, ô magni magna propago patris,
Te neque dulcedo fallat, neque vexet amaror,
Quin potius currat sors moderata tibi.
Cecidi cadente, iacente nunc iaceo miser.
Aeolus Aeolia quisnam dicatur in aula,
Claudere nunc ventis, nunc referare fores

page.notes: Several words in the Greek-letter and italic lines are uncertain (e.g. "Tantem", "Dicere" line end, "vexet"); the scan is damaged at the right edge of the lines. Greek characters on the first line were not legible enough to transcribe; the Greek verse of the epigram is absent from the transcription. Possibly printing errors remain as printed.
